# House rules

- Language: modern JavaScript as ES modules (`.mjs`). UK English in all text and comments.
- No dependencies. Use only Node's built-in modules.
- Test with `npm test` (Node's built-in test runner). Every change needs a test. Run `npm test` before finishing and state the result.
- Do not change the behaviour of existing exports. Add new ones beside them.
- Keep changes small. No unrelated refactors.
- Excuses are light-hearted and harmless. No real people, no real registrations.
- In the pull request, say what changed, what you ran and what you did not verify.
